text:
🚨 BREAKING: President Trump just WALKED OUT of the White House to depart for Asia and says he might meet KIM JONG UN — on top of Xi and Putin

Huge!

"We're going to the Philippines, a big meeting meetings on mostly economics, but a lot of other things will be discussed...And then we go to China, and we'll be with President Xi. He was here a month ago. And we're also going to meet with President Putin. And we may meet with Kim Jong Un also. So that'll be good. We have a chance to accomplish a lot!" 👏🏻
